      have Z := GraphChoices.successNumber (fun u => GraphChoices.allBlocksEvent (bucket ↑u) k s) ω;

  (α : C → ℕ) (s : GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.State L R C) (k : ℕ)
  (es : List (GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.Arrival L R C)) (u : L) (i : C),
  (GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.runFrom α s es).threshold u i =
    s.threshold u i +
      GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.incidentCount
        (GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.thresholdArrivals (GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.traceFrom α s k es)) u i
name: GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.threshold_counter_exact_from

statement:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {C : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype E] [inst_1 : DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E]
  [inst_3 : Fintype L] [inst_4 : Fintype R] [inst_5 : Fintype C] [inst_6 : DecidableEq L] [inst_7 : DecidableEq R]
  [inst_8 : DecidableEq C] (H : C → GraphChoices.Peeling.Graph L R)
  (encode : E → GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ) (T D k B N c : ℕ),
  0 < N →
    Fintype.card L ≤ N →
      Fintype.card R ≤ N →
        GraphChoices.polynomialCutoff N c ≤ D + 1 →
          GraphChoices.polynomialCutoff N c ≤ k →
            (∀ (u : L),
                Real.exp 1 * ↑T * (↑(GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.leftSourceBucket encode u).card / ↑(Fintype.card E)) /
                    (↑D + 1) ≤
                  1 / 2) →
              GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.largeHeavyTreeEvent encode α T k ⊆
                  GraphChoices.Patterns.largeShapeEvent H encode α T k B →
                (∀ j ≤ B,
                    GraphChoices.eventProbability (GraphChoices.Patterns.heavyShapeEvent H encode α T (k + j)) ≤
                      ↑(Fintype.card R) / 2 ^ (k + j)) →
                  GraphChoices.eventProbability
                      (GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.largeComponentEvent encode α T ((D + 1) * (k + 1))) ≤
                    3 / ↑N ^ c
name: GraphChoices.Patterns.largeComponent_polynomial_tail_of_coverage

statement: ∀ (N : ℕ), 0 < GraphChoices.iteratedLog N
name: GraphChoices.iteratedLog_pos

statement: ∀ (b t m : ℕ), Fintype.card (GraphChoices.LowerBound.Vertices b t m) = m * GraphChoices.LowerBound.layerSum t (b + 1)
name: GraphChoices.LowerBound.card_vertices

statement:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [inst_2 : DecidableRel G.Adj] (left : V → Bool),
  G.Connected → ∀ (root : V), left root = true → (SimpleGraph.induce (GraphChoices.prunedVertices G left) G).Connected
name: GraphChoices.pruned_induce_connected

statement:
∀ {E : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {C : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype E] [inst_1 : DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E]
  [inst_3 : Fintype L] [inst_4 : Fintype R] [inst_5 : DecidableEq L] [inst_6 : DecidableEq R] [inst_7 : DecidableEq C]
  (encode : E → GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.Arrival L R C) (α : C → ℕ) (T D k : ℕ),
  GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.largeComponentEvent encode α T ((D + 1) * (k + 1)) ⊆
    GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.largeLeftDegreeEvent encode α T D ∪
      GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.largeHeavyTreeEvent encode α T k
name: GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.largeComponent_subset_degree_or_tree

statement:
∀ {L : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} {C : Type u_4} [inst : DecidableEq L] [inst_1 : DecidableEq R]
  {xs ys : List (GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.Arrival L R C)},
  xs.Sublist ys →
    ∀ (u : L), GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.listLeftNeighbors xs u ⊆ GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.listLeftNeighbors ys u
name: GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.listLeftNeighbors_mono

statement: {V : Type u_1} → {E : Type u_2} → GraphChoices.BaseGraph V E → (V → ℕ) → E × Bool → Bool
name: GraphChoices.RandomGreedy.choice

statement:
∀ (mean f z A B : ℝ),
  0 ≤ f * mean → 0 ≤ A → 0 ≤ B → f * mean ≤ A → z ≤ B → ↑(GraphChoices.sufficientThreshold mean f z) ≤ A + B + 2
name: GraphChoices.sufficientThreshold_upper

statement:
∀ {L : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype L] [inst_1 : Fintype R] [inst_2 : DecidableEq L]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq R] {G : GraphChoices.Peeling.Graph L R} {B N : ℕ} {d : ℝ} [Nonempty { x // x ∈ G }]
  (P : GraphChoices.Peeling.PreparedDecomposition G B N d) (T c : ℕ),
  0 < T →
    T ≤ N →
      5 ≤ c →
        Fintype.card (L ⊕ R) ≤ N →
          2 * ↑(Finset.card G) = ↑N * d →
            GraphChoices.eventProbability
                (GraphChoices.ThresholdGreedy.largeComponentEvent P.encode (P.thresholds T) T
                  (3 * (GraphChoices.polynomialCutoff N c + 1) ^ 2)) ≤
              3 / ↑N ^ c
name: GraphChoices.Peeling.PreparedDecomposition.component_tail

statement:
∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype V] [inst_1 : DecidableEq V] {T : ℕ} (I : GraphChoices.Instance V T),
  0 ≤ GraphChoices.maxDensity I
name: GraphChoices.maxDensity_nonneg
